scripts.check: npm run check:api && npm run check:web && npm run check:widget
scripts.check:api: uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api/app apps/api/tests && uv run --project apps/api mypy apps/api/app apps/api/tests && uv run --project apps/api pytest apps/api/tests
scripts.check:web: npm run lint --workspace @support-agent/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @support-agent/web
scripts.check:widget: npm run lint --workspace @support-agent/widget && npm run typecheck --workspace @support-agent/widget
